title: Susan Clancy's Harvard study of abductees

tellings.quote: Also, there was, you know, Susan Clansancy at Harvard for a doctoral dissertation in psychology. She wrote a book on abducted and she did a study on people who had been abducted by alien.

plain: A psychologist named Susan Clancy studied people who say they were abducted by aliens, as doctoral research in psychology at Harvard, and wrote a book about them called Abducted. The skeptic Michael Shermer brings her work up on the show during a debate with Michels about UFOs. He offers it as a scientific look at such claims, though he does not say here what she found.
